model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across different language families for six model variants. The horizontal axis is labeled "family" and contains nine categorical groups arranged from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 30, with gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 5 (though labeled at 10, 20, and 30). Each language family group contains up to six bars corresponding to six model variants as indicated in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink/salmon), and XLM-B₂ (red). Most bars include error bars indicating variability. The tallest bars appear in the IE-Indic group, where XLM-R₂ and mBERT-R₂ reach approximately 23–24 and XLM-B₂ reaches about 21. The IE-Germanic group shows bars ranging from roughly 5 to 15, while IE-Romance bars range from approximately 6 to 18. IE-Slavic shows values from roughly 5 to 18. IE-Baltic bars are relatively short, ranging from about 2 to 7. IE-other bars range from approximately 5 to 8. The Isolate group has very small bars near 0, some slightly negative. The Semitic group shows notable variation, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ reaching approximately 15 and 20 respectively, while the L₂ and R₂ variants are near 0 or slightly negative. The Uralic group similarly has small bars mostly near 0, with some slightly negative values. Error bars are particularly large for the Semitic and IE-Indic groups. The bars are not sorted by value but rather grouped by language family, and no bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
